summary: The milestone completed 13 experiments in 4.1 minutes, with 10 classified as compute-bound. No compute-task GPU-idle fault was established; fallback timing reconstruction and missing task-linked phase and concurrency telemetry limit the efficiency diagnosis.
bottlenecks_identified: Live git-log timing found no commits, so disk modification times had to reconstruct the milestone and could not attribute elapsed time to execution phases.
Model-family factor harness development and held-split freeze was the longest compute-bound entry at 1.39 minutes, but the supplied data provides no phase breakdown that explains why.
The GPU snapshot is not correlated with an active experiment, execution phase, model count, or runner dispatch, preventing a task-time utilization and concurrency assessment.
improvements_suggested: Persist monotonic start, stop, and phase timestamps for every experiment so live records replace disk-mtime reconstruction.
Attach GPU utilization samples to the active experiment and phase, together with model-count, concurrency-window, and runner-dispatch receipts.

Add a gate-aware ready queue that evaluates prerequisites before launch and dispatches independent eligible compute work concurrently; select DualGPURunner only when multiple models are actually loaded in parallel.
Retain the existing failure-ledger pre-launch check and continue treating its fast doomed-rerun blocks as saved time rather than runtime bottlenecks.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Replace fallback reconstruction with durable per-experiment and per-phase monotonic timing.
Correlate GPU samples with task identity, compute phase, model concurrency, and runner selection.
Schedule gate-ready independent compute work concurrently and route only genuine parallel multi-model work through DualGPURunner.
meta_reflection: The record ranks the operational tail but does not support causal attribution for the longest task, a compute-time GPU efficiency grade, or a parallel-model runner finding. The next retrospective should distinguish measured execution defects from missing observability at task and phase boundaries.
